circuit.title: Board services: ID-EEPROM, RTC, watchdog, QWIIC

WATCHDOG_KICK.expect: som_j3_connector (PL bank-33 +3V3/LVCMOS33 — watchdog kick/event, xdc.py live)

WATCHDOG_RST_N.expect: som_j3_connector (PL bank-33 +3V3/LVCMOS33 — watchdog kick/event, xdc.py live)

decap_waivers.V_RTC_BAT: VBACKUP is the RV-3028 coin-cell backup input (a rechargeable ML1220, not a switching rail); the RTC regulates internally and a cap on the cell net is optional — no bypass fitted by design

reset_waivers.WATCHDOG_RST_N: TPS3823 RESET# is a push-pull supervisor OUTPUT driving a PL bank-33 input as a firmware-mediated event (not a POR line): no pull needed (push-pull; PL internal pull holds it when +3V3_AUX is OFF), no cap by design (logic-event edge)
